comment: She's quiet and nice, but not a good teacher. She is frequently unprepared for class and often late, though doesn't give students the opportunity to make up assignments they missed in class. There are very unclear assignments and grading criteria, which leaves students confused and unsure how to complete assignments correctly. Would not recommend

I think that Reinaga is criticized very harshly. She is very sweet. Though she's not great at teaching the material, it's really easy to teach yourself. There are lot of in class activities which are annoying but overall, I would pick Reinaga for level 211.

Professor Reinaga is a very nice woman and a decent professor. She is always willing to help if you ask! She speaks Spanish most of the time but has no problem in being asked questions in English. The quizzes are very easy and the test and challenging but not too bad if you study. Everything you do in the class prepares you for the final.

She is a good teacher and an interesting person. She is difficult to understand and expectations are not clear. I would not take her class again as grades, tests, and quizzes are unpredictable and difficult to study for. She does not let students keep tests or quizzes which makes it difficult to study.

This is an intensive class so there is a bit of teaching yourself things that she thinks that we should already know. She speaks in Spanish quite a bit of the time but allows you to speak English if you really need to in order to ask a question and speaks English to explain hard topics. Most everything you do in class is straight forward.

Going into this class, I worried about some negative reviews I had read. However, they're all wrong! Lucia is such a sweet person, and she genuinely cares about helping you learn Spanish. Homework is daily online. Tests aren't too bad. The class can be rich because it is so frequent, but Lucia always brightened my day with her friendly personality.

221 is everyday and it becomes a drag.  Homework is every single day on Supersite plus compositions and other things. Class has its up and down days. You learn about random culture aspects and watch random short films. Quizzes can be easy if you actually keep up with the work and study in your free time. A good grade is not out of reach.
